metadata.description: vaETH Pool (vaETH) is a Vesper Finance yield-bearing vault on Ethereum that accepts ETH deposits. Depositors receive vaETH tokens representing their share of the pool; yield generated by the pool's underlying strategies is used to buy back additional ETH, so each vaETH token appreciates in ETH terms over time. The contract is deployed as an EIP-1967 transparent upgradeable proxy, with logic held in a separately upgradeable implementation contract.
